paths.description: Mandatory Portuguese age-verification and cookie-decision entry state at desktop, preferences, keyboard focus, and 360x800 mobile.
Homepage content after confirming age; represents the primary video-card feed and global navigation.
Video listing and category deep links; represents browse/index templates and first-visit route continuity.
Representative video detail/player template, including metadata and captions.
Public login dialog; inspected labels, disclosure, and autocomplete without using credentials.
Unknown route to inspect HTTP/runtime failure messaging and recovery.

findings.summary: The mandatory age-verification entry does not reflow at a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot clips the logo, heading, notice link, body copy, and second decision button beyond the right viewport edge.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace fixed/min-width age-gate sizing with fluid inline sizes, wrapping text and buttons inside max-inline-size:100%; verify at 320-400px.

findings.summary: The site uses a fixed dark palette rather than declaring support for the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rules; the emulated preference capture is visually identical to the default.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and express surface/text tokens with light-dark() or prefers-color-scheme, while retaining the brand dark option.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use an intentional View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM feature probe found no authored view-transition names or transition rules around modal and route changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained same-document View Transition for modal/state changes and preserve a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Mandatory overlays are implemented as large custom modal structures instead of native dialog primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection shows custom age/cookie modal wrappers; no native dialog element was used for these blocking surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> with showModal(), labelled headings, focus containment, and platform close semantics where dismissal is allowed.

findings.summary: Advertising and third-party chrome consume a disproportionate share of the browsing surface and payload.
findings.evidence: The post-gate HAR recorded 101 third-party requests and 2.30MB of third-party transfer, while the content probe found 156 visible interactive elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce ad slots and duplicated promotional controls, reserve more viewport space for the primary content, and load nonessential chrome on demand.

findings.summary: Components rely on page-level fixed sizing rather than adapting within narrow containers.
findings.evidence: The mobile capture is a clipped 780px-style surface at 360px, and the CSS probe found no container queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the age gate, header, cards, and action groups intrinsic sizing and container-query breakpoints rather than desktop minimum widths.

findings.summary: Many keyboard focus states are absent and several interactive text targets are too short.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reported outline:none for the first cookie links and primary nav links; multiple targets were only 15-16px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply a high-contrast :focus-visible ring to every interactive element and increase compact links to at least a comfortable 24px CSS target, preferably 44px for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: First-visit age confirmation loses listing and category deep links.
findings.evidence: Probes starting at /video and /categories ended at https://pt.pornhub.com/ after confirming age, rather than restoring the requested route.
findings.suggestedFix: Persist the intended URL through age verification and navigate back to it after successful confirmation.

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently recover to homepage content without identifying the error.
findings.evidence: The unknown-route probe returned homepage content and navigation with no 404 heading, explanation, or targeted recovery action.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 status and a clear localized error page with search, home, and popular-section recovery actions.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is far outside the good threshold.
findings.evidence: The DevTools trace measured FCP at 2.86s and LCP at 6.17s; Lighthouse performance scored 0.52.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten document response and LCP discovery, prioritize only the LCP asset, and defer ads and below-fold modules until after primary content.

findings.summary: Resource delivery is heavy and includes a broad render-blocking dependency set.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 172 requests and 5.79MB transferred, including seven parser-blocking stylesheets plus synchronous parser-inserted script candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, split page-specific styles, defer noncritical scripts, and reduce the duplicate document/XHR payload.

findings.summary: Substantial JavaScript and CSS ship unused on the entry path.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 288KiB unused JavaScript and 74KiB unused CSS; HAR recorded 40 scripts and 11 stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template, remove duplicate legacy bundles, and conditionally load advertising and account dependencies.

findings.summary: Advertising iframes lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe-core found 30 serious frame-title violations after age confirmation.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each meaningful iframe a concise title and hide non-content frames from the accessibility tree only when truly decorative.

findings.summary: The document lacks robust landmarks and visible focus across the main navigation.
findings.evidence: axe found 116 nodes outside landmarks; the homepage has no H1, and the focus probe found outline:none on primary nav links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/nav/section landmarks, one page H1, and consistent :focus-visible styling without changing visual order.

findings.summary: The sampled video has no caption track.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found a controlled video element with zero <track> caption/subtitle resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide synchronized WebVTT captions and expose language-labelled caption controls in the player.

findings.summary: The page logs browser console errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console failed and reported one logged browser error.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the logged request/runtime error and keep production console output free of uncaught failures.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs, DevTools issues, and bfcache blockers remain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported two deprecation warnings, one Inspector issue, and four back/forward cache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs, resolve the Inspector issue, and remove unload/state patterns that prevent bfcache restoration.

findings.summary: Page titles and descriptions do not identify the current content.
findings.evidence: The homepage and sampled detail both reported the generic title “Pornhub”; the detail lacked a page-specific meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique localized titles and concise descriptions for home, listings, categories, and each video detail.

findings.summary: Crawler-facing links and robots signals are broken.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 18 non-crawlable links and 4,071 robots.txt errors; direct /robots.txt redirected to the homepage. Raw/rendered content overlap was only 28%.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid text/plain robots.txt, replace javascript:void(0) navigation with real hrefs, and render primary listing links server-side.

findings.summary: Canonical and indexing signals collapse distinct content to the homepage.
findings.evidence: The detail probe declared the homepage canonical and noindex,nofollow; /sitemap.xml returned 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonicals and intentional index directives per localized page, plus a sitemap of canonical public URLs.

findings.summary: Video details lack structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The sampled detail had no JSON-LD and no Open Graph tags despite having a visible H1 and playable media.
findings.suggestedFix: Add matching VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata with localized title, description, canonical URL, thumbnail, and duration.

findings.summary: The security policy baseline is incomplete and one cookie is insecure.
findings.evidence: Headers lacked CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy. Cookie audit found rp without Secure and all seven cookies using SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, restrictive referrer/permissions policies, and Secure/Lax or Strict cookie defaults except where cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The initial experience sends a large amount of data to advertising and analytics origins.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found 11 third-party origins including GTM and DoubleClick; HAR attributed 101 requests and 2.30MB to third parties.
findings.suggestedFix: Block nonessential analytics/advertising until explicit consent, minimize event fields, and reduce vendors and request volume.

findings.summary: The public login flow exposes password and social login but no passkey option.
findings.evidence: The login probe found email/current-password autofill and social buttons, but no WebAuthn/passkey capability.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey sign-in and management alongside the existing password fallback, initiated only in the login context.

findings.summary: Core post-age content depends heavily on JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability comparison found only 28% of rendered content words in raw HTML; the crawler and browser views differ materially.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the main listing and links, keeping age confirmation and enhancements additive rather than required for content discovery.

findings.summary: HTTP/network failure recovery is not represented clearly.
findings.evidence: A nonexistent route produced homepage content instead of a localized failure state or retry/recovery message.
findings.suggestedFix: Create explicit 404 and fetch-failure states with status, retry, and safe navigation; preserve stale content where possible.

findings.summary: The localized layout does not show bidirectional-ready CSS practices.
findings.evidence: The document correctly uses lang=pt, but has no dir attribute and the source probe found no logical margin/padding/inset properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction from locale and migrate physical spacing/alignment to logical properties so future RTL locales reflow safely.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks responsive sources and modern formats.
findings.evidence: Image probe found 33 images without srcset, 25 legacy-format images, three without dimensions, and two below-fold images not lazy loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width/height, srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP variants; keep below-fold thumbnails lazy and correctly prioritized.

findings.summary: The third-party and media budget is excessive for the entry journey.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 5.79MB, including 2.30MB third-party data and 1.53MB images; 101 of 172 requests were third party.
findings.suggestedFix: Set route budgets, delay ads until after consent/interaction, cap slots, and remove low-value third-party requests.
